correction: The V1 KD heads were fitted using the whole target teacher pool before prediction. V2/V3 inherit those heads. This is dataset-transductive, not video-stream-causal.
V1_local_graph: uses only own-video teacher evidence, but compared against global batch KD; comparisons are diagnostic and not proof of matched online TTA superiority
V2_V3: same batch teacher-trained heads as baselines, hence matched batch scope; not video-stream TTA proof
next_protocol: strict video-stream causality: fit only past+current video teacher feedback; current video may be transductive; no future video normalization or fitted batch checkpoint
teacher_replay: static frozen teacher recordings are split by policy and video; shared preparation cost is not deployment wall
